title: Great Assortment
text: Great Assortment. These are nice, uniform labels. They make my spice cabinet look quite organized. There are a couple of things I would change if I could. The first being the placement of the spice name. I know it looks nice and centered where the name is, but I keep my spices on one of those "stair step" type racks in my cabinet. I cannot easily see the names of the spices on the 2nd and 3rd rows. My taller husband can see them much better. If the spice name was closer to the top of the label, it would be easier for me to see. Secondly, there are a couple of spices that could use 2 labels. For example, I have ground cumin and cumin seeds. There was only one cumin label. Same with cloves & sage - I have 2 different types but only one label. There were a few ones that had this covered already with 2 separate labels. Of course, I could use a blank one, but I am not crazy with how that would look next to the nicely printed ones.
